item.title: Sourcery
item.description: Sourcery started as a Python refactoring tool built into the IDE and has expanded into automated pull request review, suggesting concrete code improvements for readability, performance, and adherence to best practices.

item.title: Codeflash
item.description: Codeflash analyzes Python functions, generates candidate optimizations, and verifies each one for correctness and measured speedup before opening a pull request, focusing specifically on runtime performance rather than general style or bugs.
